item.title: Atelier 1.5.3
item.description:
The photo works as usual beside a panel slid out from the rail, and Before and After and the zoom readout show what you expect.
### Improved - **Panels slid out from the rail:** with the right panel as icons and a section slid out (not pinned), everything on the photo now works as usual: click, drag, double-click, right-click, pinch, scroll and ⌘-scroll, a light's handles, eyedroppers and the Targeted Adjustment Tool. A click on the photo no longer closes the panel; Esc, its ✕ or its icon on the rail do.
### Fixed - **Before and After with a light's handles out:** Y and the Before and After buttons now show Slider or Side by Side straight away and put the light's handles away. Before, the buttons changed but the photo didn't until Light Layers closed. Clicking the light (or H) brings the handles back and turns Before and After off. Y does nothing while Crop, AI, Masking, Guided Upright or Remove is out, like the greyed-out buttons. - **Zoom readout:** the zoom under the photo no longer shows 2% for a photo at Fit after switching Before and After, and Side by Side shows its own Fit (for example 20%, not the single view's 35%).

item.title: Atelier 1.5.2
item.description:
Lights can be moved again when Light Layers slides out from the rail.
### Fixed - **Light Layers on the rail:** with the right panel as icons and Light Layers slid out (not pinned), clicking a light's pin closed the panel and hid the handles, so a Lens Flare or any other light couldn't be moved, sized or turned. The handles now take the click and the panel stays open.

item.title: Atelier 1.5.1
item.description:
Atelier 1.5.0 quit right after opening on some Macs. This version opens normally.
### Fixed - **Opening Atelier:** 1.5.0 could quit as soon as it opened while it added the Starter Looks. It now finds them reliably, and if they're ever missing, Atelier opens without them instead of quitting.

item.title: Atelier 1.5.0
item.description:
Light and color added over your photos, presets that apply several looks at once, and the photo's commands on the rail.
### New - **Light Layers:** a Develop panel after Effects that adds generated light over the photo: Light Leak, Color Wash, Lens Flare, Prism, Bokeh and Sun Rays. Add Light places each one where it reads well, and every layer has its own Amount, blend, colors, size, angle and position. Lights are drawn fresh at any size, so exports stay sharp. Lens Flare has its own Rays, Ghosts, Streak and Halo. - **Combined presets:** save several presets as one, such as a film tone, a color grade and a light, and apply them in one click. Once applied, the photo just has ordinary settings. Right-click › Edit Combined Preset… changes one later. - **Starter Looks and the Light & Color pack:** ready-made looks and light stacks to start from. They're your own copies, so you can change or delete them. - **Before and Photo actions on the rail:** with View › Right Panel › Icons Only, the bottom of the rail has Before (lit while on) and … , which slides out Copy, Paste, Before and Reset. Return opens it, ← → move, Esc closes. - **Reset a panel from the rail:** right-click a panel's icon for Reset and Turn Off/On, or ⌥-click it to reset it without opening it. Panel headers' right-click menus start with the same.
### Improved - **Develop's bar:** Copy, Paste, Before and Reset have icons, the same as on the rail. - **Photo right-click menu:** Edit In now starts with Edit in HDR and Edit in Lens Blur, then your other apps. On the photo itself, Open in Loupe and the zoom items are gone; the zoom is in the bar under the photo.

item.title: Atelier 1.4.2
item.description:
Develop's tools switch without a flash, and Constrain Crop shows its crop right away.
### Fixed - **Switching Heal, Masking and AI:** the photo stays exactly as it is on screen, with no dark frame, in the full panel and on the rail. Changing photos with a tool open doesn't flash either. - **Rail and tools:** clicking another rail icon (Basic, Tone Curve…) while Heal, Masking or AI is out closes that tool, so its cursor and marks leave the photo. - **Guided Upright and Show Whole Photo at 100%:** the photo changes to each new view at once. - **Constrain Crop:** the photo takes the constrained crop at once, even zoomed in with Guided open. Unchecking it brings back the framing you had before, including a crop you drew.

item.title: Atelier 1.4.1
item.description:
Smoother right panel, and a keyboard that goes everywhere the mouse does.
### Improved - **Right panel:** switching between Full Panel, Icons Only and Hidden is one smooth slide, with no flicker, and the photo moves only once. - **Remove, Masking and AI on the rail:** their panels float over the photo's edge, so the photo doesn't shrink or redraw when they open. Pin docks them beside the rail. - **Moving around with ⌃Tab:** ⌃Tab and ⌃⇧Tab go round the window clockwise: toolbar, right panel, rail, Notes, the grid, the Filmstrip, then the left column. Only what's on screen is a stop, so a hidden left column or Filmstrip is skipped. - **Toolbar from the keyboard:** ⌃Tab reaches the toolbar, Tab walks its buttons left to right, and Space or Return presses one. - **Arrow keys:** in Grid the four arrows move through the photos, and the left column's Library, Imports, Volumes and Collections work as one list with the arrows, as in the Finder's sidebar.
### Fixed - **Click and keyboard agree:** clicking a button, rail icon, checkbox or slider gives it the keyboard, so the next Tab or Space starts there. - **Arrow keys after hiding the Filmstrip:** they keep changing photos instead of doing nothing.

item.title: Atelier 1.4.0
item.description:
A right panel that folds down to a rail of icons, clearer panel headers, and Before and After that keeps your zoom.
### New - **Right panel as icons:** View > Right Panel > Full Panel, Icons Only or Hidden, in Grid, Loupe and Develop (F8 steps through them, or click the Inspector button in the toolbar; ⌥-click hides it). Icons Only leaves a slim rail beside the photo: click an icon and that section slides out, pin it to keep it open, and ⌘1 to ⌘9 open the sections in order. Dragging the panel's edge narrower snaps it to the rail. - **Develop tools on the rail:** Crop, Remove, Masking, AI and Lens Blur sit at the top of the rail; clicking one turns the tool on and opens its panel beside the rail.
### Improved - **Panel headers:** every section header has a solid band with an icon before its name, and an open section is marked, in Develop, the Library panel, the left column, HDR, Lens Blur and Import. - **Selected look:** toolbar, rail and tool strip buttons show the same soft gray circle when they're on, as in the Finder, instead of blue. - **Develop > Before and After:** Slider is now first in the menu, and both Slider and Side by Side open at the zoom you were working at. - **Filmstrip:** starts small, so the photo gets more room; drag its top edge to make it taller. - **Develop > Remove:** the Content-Aware, Heal and Clone buttons fit the panel. - **Atelier Help:** pictures and text show the new toolbar, panel headers and icon rail.
### Fixed - **AI Denoise:** the last column or row of a photo with odd dimensions is cleaned like the rest.

item.title: Atelier 1.3.0
item.description:
One-click filters in the Filmstrip, faster photo changes, and one photo viewer behind every mode.
### New - **Filmstrip filters:** the bar above the photo is gone. Filter from the Filmstrip header with one click, as in Lightroom: flag buttons, gold stars for a minimum rating, soft color squares for labels, and More for Edits and Notes. ⓧ next to Filter clears them all. - **Search in the toolbar:** the search field is now the first item in the window toolbar, in Grid, Loupe and Develop, even with the Filmstrip hidden. - **Settings > Develop > Performance > Photo quality while working:** choose how sliders trade sharpness for speed while you drag.
### Improved - **Changing photos:** the next photo shows at once from its preview and sharpens in place, with no spinner or loading bar, in Develop, Loupe and Cull. - **Zoomed editing:** drags keep up with the slider and are sharp again the moment you pause. - **Crop, AI brush and Guided Upright** use the same photo view as Develop, so zoom and Space-drag panning work the same in every tool. - **Filmstrip and Import:** portrait photos show whole instead of cropped. - **Grid thumbnail size:** the − + slider is now at the right of the status bar under the grid. - **Inspector:** rating stars are gold, as on the thumbnails.
### Fixed - **XMP sidecars:** never drop edits made by a newer Atelier. - **Keep on This Mac:** kept copies stay with their photo after a catalog restore, and Remove Photo removes them too. - **Fine Edges and Depth downloads:** Cancel works while the download is checked, and a new model replaces the old one safely. - **Navigator:** its zoom rectangle no longer shows over the next photo.

item.title: Atelier 1.2.0
item.description:
Sharper zoomed editing, steadier panels, and a diagnostic log for when something feels slow.
### New - **Diagnostic log:** Help > Diagnostic Logging (or Settings > General > Diagnostics) records Atelier’s memory use and how long things take, such as renders, photo changes, slider drags and previews, to a log you can open with Help > Show Diagnostic Log in Finder. It is off until you turn it on, it’s written in the background so Atelier doesn’t slow down, and it stays within the size you choose (25 MB to start).
### Improved - **Develop, zoomed in:** the photo stays sharp while you drag sliders or move between photos, with no low-resolution flash first. - **Loupe:** each photo appears once, sharp, instead of a soft picture that sharpens a moment later.
### Fixed - **Right panels in Loupe and Develop:** the histogram, camera settings and other readouts no longer flicker or go blank when you move to another photo.

item.title: Atelier 1.1.0
item.description:
Smoother cropping, and composition guides beyond the rule of thirds.
### New - **Crop guide overlays:** Grid, Thirds, Diagonal, Triangle, Golden Ratio, Golden Spiral and Aspect Ratios, as in Lightroom. Press O while cropping to step through them and Shift-O to turn the Triangle or Golden Spiral, or pick one in the Crop panel's Overlay menu or Develop > Crop Guide Overlay. Show them always, only while dragging, or never, and set the lines' thickness, opacity and color in Settings > Develop > Crop Overlay.
### Improved - **Crop & Straighten:** dragging a corner, an edge or the whole crop, and straightening, follow the pointer smoothly instead of stuttering.

item.title: Atelier 1.0.0
item.description:
The first copy of Atelier to share as a file. It now keeps itself up to date.
### New - **Atelier > Check for Updates…** looks for a new version on Atelier’s GitHub releases. Atelier also checks once a day by itself. - **Settings > Updates:** your version, when Atelier last checked, and whether updates download and install by themselves when you quit. Include beta versions if you want previews of the next release. - **What’s New in Atelier** opens once after each update with what changed, and any time from Help > What’s New in Atelier. - **Catalog backups before upgrades:** when a new version needs to upgrade your catalog, Atelier first saves a copy in the catalog’s Backups > Before Upgrade folder.
